notes.title: On the topic of Oculus Rift support.
notes.content:
So some interest has been shown from Oculus owners and they're asking  "Does SZEN support the Oculus Rift? Steam page says it's for HTC Vive only".
First of all, we thank you for showing interest in our little VR experience. Officially, this VR experience is only for the Vive. Unfortunately, at the time of development, we only had access to Vive headsets. [strike]BUT! Some early testers have indicated that functionally it does work with the Rift as well. The controllers may not work, but they're only needed for skipping ahead in the experience. So all that said, it "might work" on the Oculus platform, but not officially supported... yet. [/strike]   

If we see enough interest, we'll work hard to make a clean port to Oculus as well!  We want everyone to have a chance to experience this.  

EDIT: Oculus support is still an issue, so the experience will continue to be Vive in it's current version.  Thanks for your patience.
